set_text.text: Usage, buffer and the count all have to be in full cases. A count taken in eaches or broken cases makes the days left read wrong.
Where VOS fits around your trigger
Customer orders draw each line toward its trigger

VOS does not set your reorder point, count your stock or order from your suppliers. It works on the demand side: your customers order by voice in the VOS app, and inventory visibility moves with that order activity.
Real-time inventory visibility tied to order activity
Fewer stockout surprises across the catalog
Each app order shows who ordered and when
Stock figures stay in the system you run today
What to run after the reorder point
The reorder point says when to order. These free calculators answer how big the buffer should be, how far to top up, and how fast the stock sells.
